entries.zh: 刁蛮强横，不让人（不肯让人）〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: unruly and headstrong, yielding to nobody; refractory [original partly damaged, gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: 西语栏“maltez ero-”拼写难辨、汉字“鵌/鵰”有疑且 M 第五声调符涂改（T99），据 H“鵰（刁）头不让人”义暂定为不让人之刁蛮强横。

entries.zh: 刁人；刁滑害人（之人）
entries.en: cunning, troublesome fellow; mischievous, harmful (perjudicial)
entries.notes: 西语栏“e leitista”拼写难辨，据 H/M“刁人”与 perjudicial 定为刁滑害人之人。

entries.zh: 捒（字形待考）；搅拌，包裹
entries.en: to stir; to wrap up (revolver, envolver)
entries.notes: H“捒/揀”二字有疑、M“chau”与之对应不明，义依西语 revolver／envolver 暂定为搅拌包裹。

entries.zh: 纷；纷乱纠缠，牵扯缠裹
entries.en: tangled, in disorder; to entangle, involve

entries.zh: 拨；拨动搅拨〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to push aside, stir aside [original partly damaged, gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: 西语“enconpalos”难辨、M 含 T99 污损，仅据 H“拨”暂定，全条存疑。

entries.zh: 绳；搓捻绳索〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: rope; to twist a rope [original partly damaged, gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: 西语“enconpalo”难辨、M“chu”有疑且 T99 污损，仅 H“绳”（M 栏圈选）可据，暂定搓捻绳索。

entries.zh: 搅水使浑（依西语栏；汉字栏对应待考）
entries.en: to stir water so that it turns turbid
entries.notes: H“露”与 M“lai lou”同西语“enturbiando（使浑）”义不合，仅据 L 栏西语语义定释。

entries.zh: 卷；卷搅（水），打旋
entries.en: to swirl, stir the water; to roll up

entries.zh: 盘；盘绕纠缠，愈缠愈深（纠缠于某事）
entries.en: to coil round; to entangle oneself ever more with something

entries.zh: 叛；背叛作对，言语相忤
entries.en: to turn against, contradict; to rebel

entries.zh: 转；绕圈打转，来回绕行〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to turn round, go about in circles [original partly damaged, gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: M 栏中部有涂改残块、西语“o consoable”难辨，据 H“转”与 M“choan”暂定为绕转。

entries.zh: 盘拄（字形待考）；互相拌嘴争执，彼此相缠
entries.en: to wrangle, bandy words back and forth with one another
entries.notes: H 第二字“桃/逃”有疑，据 M 栏西语批注“Uno con otro”与 poan tau/poan to 两读，定为互相拌嘴相争。

entries.zh: 悖谬；乖悖谬妄，言语相违
entries.en: perverse and absurd; contradictory
entries.notes: M 后两音节“hin xin/hin lin”难辨，据 H“悖谬”与 L“contradecir”定为悖谬相违。

entries.zh: 悖逆；忤逆违抗，犯上
entries.en: perverse and rebellious; to defy, disobey

entries.zh: 卷转绕带（中字残损待考）〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to roll and spin round, carrying round about [original partly damaged, gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: M 第二音节有墨渍（残），H 中字疑为“輪”之形误，据 guiau/try 与西语“traer alrededor”推为旋转绕带。

entries.zh: 缠带；缠绕束带，缠裹于某物
entries.en: to wind a band round; to wrap, bind it up in something

entries.zh: 盘绕成圈，如环箍冠冕状〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to go round making a circle, ring-wise like a hoop or crown [original partly damaged, gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: H 第三字“箍/簍”有疑、M 含 T99 污损；首字“温”疑为“圓”之借写，据西语“haciendo círculo o como corona”暂定盘绕成圈。

entries.zh: 盘旋成圈（H“温成温”之“温”疑为“圓”借写）；如水在木板上打旋
entries.en: to swirl round and round like water on a plank
entries.notes: “温成温”按字面与西语义不合，据 L/M“on chia on”及上条成圈义推“温”为“圓”之借字，存疑。

entries.zh: 刁头人；挑拨生事、拨弄是非之人
entries.en: a meddling trouble-stirrer; cf. Sp. malsín, insidious backbiter
entries.notes: H 首字“鵰/鵝”有疑；古西语 malsín 为搬弄是非者，与 H/M“刁头人”相合，定为挑事之人。

entries.zh: 绕行打转（依西语栏；汉字栏字义待考）
entries.en: to circle round about (per Spanish lemma only)
entries.notes: H“个”与 M“se”同西语“绕行”义无法互证，无法定夺本条实义。
